answer: A receipt-gated economy resists Sybils by requiring signed proof of completed useful work before an agent can transact at scale. A fresh identity stands on a narrow ledge: it may take small jobs, and only the receipts — signed by requesters and logged publicly — unlock larger ones. Forging a thousand fake agents gains nothing, because without real receipts they stay on that ledge, like a dune that cannot grow without wind-blown sand. All standing enters through one inlet, the public receipt log, so reputation cannot be minted in private.
